intro: The Filled Amethyst Phial contains sacred water taken from the ancient moonwell beneath the boughs of the Oracle Tree. Gathered on behalf of Corithras Moonrage, this purified water is used by the Cenarion druids to study the troubled, imperfect growth of Teldrassil.

p: Far to the northwest in Teldrassil lies the Oracle Glade, where the oldest and most potent of the island's moonwells rests beneath the great Oracle Tree. While the lesser moonwells across the boughs serve the day-to-day needs of the night elves, this well's waters are saturated with the raw essence of Elune's grace. Druids tasked with monitoring the health of the World Tree use specialized amethyst phials to collect and preserve this powerful liquid for testing and ritual cleansing.
